Home.headline: I transform ideas into end-to-end Android applications using AI assistants and modern technologies.

About.title: About
About.intro: Instead of traditional coding processes, I develop Android applications by directing AI tools like Gemini and Claude. I manage the software production process by combining ideas with user experience goals.
About.processDesc1: I managed the development process of Kotlin and Jetpack Compose based Android applications by directing AI assistants.
About.processDesc2: I structured the processes of AstroYorum, NotesAssistant, OptiDoc, and ValutaRate applications from the idea stage to the publication stage.

skills.prompting: Directing Gemini and Claude models to establish app architecture and resolve logic errors.
skills.android: Building Android applications in Kotlin using AI assistants.
skills.firebase: Managing the process of adding cloud database, user authentication, and ad services to applications.
